name: Buckeye Broadband (Buckeye Cable System)
notes: Researched from public buckeyebroadband.com support FAQs only (no sign-in; the myBuckeye sign-on now redirects to a SAML login that was not opened). myBuckeye sign-up: Register (upper right), verify identity with last name, phone number and account number (or SSN), then an email address, a password (8-20 characters with a number) and three security questions, then verify the email; the sign-on page asks for an email address (per search-indexed sign-on page; registration chooses that email), so identifier is email, evidence inferred. Online billing lives in the Bill Pay portal reached by View/Pay Bill: Billing Preferences > Enroll Now for AutoPay (bank, Visa/Mastercard/Discover/Amex credit, Visa/Mastercard debit), Payment Accounts for saved methods, and paperless (eBill) in Billing Preferences. Printed statement fee conflict: the eBill and AutoPay pages say $5.00 per month, the most-common-questions FAQ says $2.00; help uses the eBill page figure and names the conflict nowhere customer-facing (open question for the reviewer). Late payment: a $19.00 charge when the bill is not paid by the due date (lateFeeCents 1900). Pay by phone: 419-828-0022, an agent verifies the account then transfers to the automated system (no fee stated). No pay-without-signing-in option is described (the Pay A Bill page links only to the signed-in portal, payment centers and phone), so guest_pay is unsupported (inferred). How to stop AutoPay is not described, so autopay_cancel keeps the family default. Cancelling is by phone at 419-828-0022 (24/7); moves can be requested in myBuckeye. Payment fees for online payments are not stated (inferred free). Reviewer (t20, 2026-10-10): Re-checked all eight cited pages plus the Legal page's 2026 Residential Rates card (PDF, 2026-09). The rate card resolves the printed-statement conflict at $5.00 (the most-common-questions FAQ's $2/$19 is outdated) and lists Payment Late Fee $18.00, so lateFeeCents is now 1800 (task and expectation updated); it also lists a $5.00 Non-Enrolled AutoPay Fee (now an AutoPay note, fee note, help article and task), Returned Check $35.00 and Service Restart $10.00. Registration fields (last name, phone, account number or SSN, email) confirmed.

notes: Mailed Printed Statement Fee: $5.00 a month unless you choose eBill.
Non-Enrolled AutoPay Fee: $5.00 a month if you are not enrolled in AutoPay.
Returned Check Fee: $35.00. Service Restart Fee: $10.00.

help.title: Ways to pay your Buckeye bill
paragraphs: Pay online in myBuckeye or the myBuckeye app with View/Pay Bill, set up AutoPay, call 419-828-0022, or pay in person at a Buckeye Broadband location with a representative or a self-service kiosk.

By phone, a Customer Support Team member confirms your account and the amount, then transfers you to the automated payment system, where you pay from checking or savings or with a credit or debit card.

help.title: Late payments and statements
paragraphs: If a bill is not paid by the due date shown at the top left of your statement, a Payment Late Fee of $18.00 is added under Other Charges. Your statement is always available in the Member Services portal.
To lower your bill, call 419-828-0022 and a representative can review your account and services with you.

help.title: AutoPay sign-up
paragraphs: Select myBuckeye Sign In, sign in, and open View/Pay Bill. Under Billing Preferences choose Enroll Now, create a payment account and follow the steps for your AutoPay method.

AutoPay works with a bank account (routing and account number), a Mastercard, Visa, Discover or American Express credit card, or a Mastercard or Visa debit card with its billing address. For a bank account you accept the AutoPay recurring charge and one-time charge terms.
steps: Select myBuckeye Sign In and sign in.
Under Billing Preferences select Enroll Now.
Add a payment account and accept the terms.

help.title: eBill paperless statements
paragraphs: Sign in to myBuckeye and answer Yes to the Go Paperless prompt, or open View/Pay Bill and manage paperless statements under Billing Preferences. Going paperless avoids the $5.00 monthly printed statement fee, and your statements stay available online anytime.

help.title: Cancelling Buckeye service
paragraphs: To cancel, call 419-828-0022; the local customer support team is available 24/7. If you are moving instead, request a transfer of your services to your new home through your myBuckeye account.

help.title: Billing fees
paragraphs: Buckeye's 2026 residential rates list these billing charges: Payment Late Fee $18.00, Mailed Printed Statement Fee $5.00 a month, Non-Enrolled AutoPay Fee $5.00 a month, Returned Check Fee $35.00 and Service Restart Fee $10.00.
Choosing eBill avoids the printed statement fee, and enrolling in AutoPay avoids the Non-Enrolled AutoPay Fee.
